signs.text: One lamp, kept. Somebody fills it.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26 §5.2 (lit by one lamp that the garrison keeps)

signs.text: A kneeling-stone, two hollows worn in it. Nobody comes down here to pray who has not come to bury.
signs.src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §5 (the Burial's chapel: an altar, a lamp, a kneeling-stone; Griz 09-26d: to all three of the Triad)

signs.text: The Forge-Father's niche. The anvil here is small, a grave-anvil; nothing was ever struck on it.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (the Dwarven Triad); spine-recut §5 (the chapel to all three)

signs.text: Rekknar's ledger-stone. The last line on it is a name, and the line under it is ruled and empty.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Rekknar the Reckoner); spine-recut §5

signs.text: A plain cut in the rock with nothing in it. The Dormant's. Down here it looks like an open niche.
signs.src: wiki/pantheon.md (Dvalgarda, the vigil); spine-recut §5 (the sect is never named here)

signs.text: A sealed door, warranted. The runes are whole. The ledger knows what is behind it; you do not.
signs.src: spine-recut §5 (the hallway: sealed doors off it; nothing behind them this round)
